objet: Your French tax residency and IFI exposure
disponibilite: I remain at your disposal for any question.

corps.p: Whether your student years already made you a French tax resident is a facts-based question, assessed year by year under French law and the France-United States tax treaty (days of presence, home, centre of economic interests). The answer matters twice for the IFI. It determines the years for which a filing may already have been due, once taxable real estate exceeds 1.3 million euros. It also fixes the starting point of the five-year period during which new residents are taxed on their French real estate only, and if your student years count, part of that window has already run. We regularly handle this type of matter for U.S. nationals settling in France.

We deliver a written analysis you can rely on, fixing your residency status for each year since your arrival and your resulting IFI position, so that your talent passport project starts on a clean footing.

The most efficient next step is a short call. I suggest tomorrow morning, Friday September 4, between 9.30 and 11.30. Let me know the time that suits you and we will call you on the number you provided.
Ahead of the call, three items will let us frame the analysis precisely.

corps.b: an estimate of your days of presence in France for each year since your arrival
any income tax returns filed in France or in the United States over that period
a list of the real estate you own, in France and abroad, with approximate values and any financing
